caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a brown, cylindrical vessel with a round open top, positioned upright and shown at a slight angle. The vessel has a thick, rounded rim and features a single, large looped handle attached to its left side. It is supported by three short, outwardly-angled legs at the base. The exterior surface of the vessel is decorated with evenly spaced small raised dots arranged in horizontal rows. The color palette consists mainly of shades of brown, with lighter and darker areas suggesting highlights and shadows that give the object volume and a sense of three-dimensionality. The drawing is enclosed within a double-lined rectangular border placed on an off-white background. There is a small signature by the artist in the lower right corner inside the border.
title: Cheese Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
